about: Camera agent, issue #29 (chase) and #28 (cockpit field of view). Roblox Studio EDIT mode, place 125864048446486, 2026-10-28 17:26-17:32 local, no playtest. This branch's Config/CarCamera, Rules/CarCamera, Vehicle/Geometry, Cars/Types, Cars/SVJ and Controllers/ChaseView were loaded from a localhost server into a temporary ServerStorage folder (ChaseView's two requires of the camera config and rules pointed at the copies), the poses built by ChaseView.place, every vertex of every visible MeshPart of workspace.CarImport (EditableMesh, 192,359 vertices) projected into each pose, the Studio camera put on the pose, Camera:WorldToViewportPoint run on the two extreme vertices and the viewport captured. The temporary folder was destroyed and the camera restored (0 leftovers checked). Harness scripts: drive-lab-assets/camera_chase/harness_*.luau.
model: workspace.CarImport at scale 1 (0.28 m per stud): every pose built in the car's frame in metres, mapped onto the model, and lowered by bodyRaise (0.085 m) because CarRig lifts the body at run time and the edit model is not lifted. Vertex box 2.274 x 1.066 x 4.940 m, equal to the model's bounding box.
units: width: car's horizontal extent / frame height. top, bottom, horizon: fraction of the frame height from the top. x: horizontal offset from the frame centre, in frame heights (positive right).
